notes.title: Release Date Reveal!
notes.notes:
[h2]Experience Dreams Like Never Before![/h2]

[b]We're thrilled to show you the new RELEASE DATE TRAILER and announce that Afterdream is releasing on SEPTEMBER 28, 2023![/b]

Watch the trailer and get ready to break through all barriers to reconnect with a lost loved one emerged!

[previewyoutube=MNQ5qBw_nEw;full][/previewyoutube]

Afterdream offers a singular 2D psychological horror experience with an arresting artistic style.You step into the shoes of Jennifer, exploring a mysterious world trapped between reality and dreams. 

Along this haunting journey, you'll encounter diverse specters, gather intriguing items, solve enigmatic puzzles, and uncover the hidden reasons behind Jennifer's presence in this place.

[h2]Play the Demo Now[/h2]

Try Before You Buy.

We encourage all fans of the psychological horror genre and newcomers alike to download, play, and add this game to their wishlists. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42561538/91a8f0c9263c00874e1210879977e53af695904d.png[/img]

Be a part of Jennifer's thrilling journey through dreamscapes and reality by owning the game when it officially launches on September 28th.

Best
Jesse Makkonen
Gamera Games

notes.title: Afterdream Release Date Postponed.
notes.notes:
Hey guys! :)

I've some exciting news I'd like to share, but I can't just yet. Please, stay tuned for some great news later.

I've been working incredibly hard to make Afterdream as good as possible. I initially wanted to release on March 15th, and I could've pushed the game out by then. However, I need to give Afterdream a little more time.

I expect Afterdream to be fully ready in late April or early May. I also want to release Afterdream simultaneously on PC and consoles (consoles confirmed!?), and since porting takes time, the release date is bound to go a couple of months further.

My current target for release is September 2023, which is a very realistic target.

I want to thank you for your support and understanding.
I'm doing my everything to make Afterdream worth the extra wait.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42561538/e24d085d1fa9c256a1be3df8faa6c6a0c5e2f254.png[/img]

Cheers, and have a fantastic weekend! :)

Jesse
